title: QA Manager
summary: A QA manager leads testing across several teams, products or client accounts. They set the test and automation strategy, manage test leads and engineers, own quality metrics and the testing budget, and give the final quality view before a release.
dailyDuties: Review test strategies and plans with test leads
Track automation coverage and decide what to automate next
Publish defect leakage and release readiness metrics
Run defect triage and go/no-go meetings with product and engineering
Plan QA capacity, tool licences and budget
Hire, coach and appraise test leads and engineers

skills.expectation: Set test strategy and test plans across products or accounts
Decide what to automate, pick tools and frameworks, and track automation ROI
Know at least one UI automation stack well enough to review frameworks
Know at least one UI automation stack well enough to review frameworks
Report defect leakage, coverage and release readiness to leadership
Run automated suites in CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing
Run defect triage and defect management across teams
Plan QA budgets, tool licences and capacity
Manage test leads and QA engineers across several teams, including hiring
Agree quality gates and go/no-go decisions with product, engineering and clients
Guide API test automation for services
Plan load and performance testing before releases
Coordinate user acceptance testing with business users
Manage testing vendors and tool suppliers
Present quality status to senior leaders

groups.label: A UI automation tool (Selenium, Playwright or Cypress)

certifications.why: Named as desirable in India QA manager postings
Shows depth in automation strategy and frameworks
Common baseline that many testing teams still ask for
